Withdrawal of a bid or refusal to accept an award of contract with the NPCIL without justifiable c ause, after being adjudged as the successful bidder. 1.1.9. Supply of Counterfeit items Breach of Code of Integrity. 1.1.10. Bidder shall not act in contravention of the codes which includes 1.1.10.1 Prohibition of a. The c ontractor shall also be given an opportunity for oral hearing to present the case in person to NPCIL and the date of Oral Hearing will be indicated in the Show Cause Notice. Only the regular employe es of Contractor will be permitted to represent the Contractor during the oral hearing, and no outsi der shall be allowed to represent the Contractor on their behalf. 1.3 Period of Banning The period of banning shall be for a period of not exceeding 2 (two) years and not less than 6 (six) months as considered appropriate by NPCIL. 1.4 Effect of Banning of Business Dealings by NPCIL In case NPCIL has banned the business dealing with the bidder/contractor, the following shall be th e consequences on issuance of the order of banning of business dealings with the bidder/contractor : 1.4.1 No Contract of any kind whatsoever shall be placed to such banned firms including its allied firms after the issue of Banning Order by NPCIL. As indicated in CERT-In guidelines, contractor shall implement information security measures to pro tect all data pertaining to NPCIL from breaches, unauthorized disclosures and implement necessary restrictions on copying and printing the same, during the currency of contract and afterwards also (if data is preserved for reasons justified and accepted by NPCIL). ormation assets / data shall be handed over to NPCIL on completion of contract and deleted from co ntractor’s storage devices unless preservation of certain data is justified, and permitted by NPCIL, po st contract. 3. The report of audit along with compliance to re commendation shall be preserved and submitted on demand. 4. CERT-In guidelines of incidents reporting shall be followed by the contractor. Any incident/event/an omaly/breach in the IT asset deployed for/of NPCIL or Data related to NPCIL observed by contractor s hall be reported to NPCIL within a reasonable period of time, as prescribed by CERT-In. 5. As per CERT-In guidelines NPCIL reserves the right to audit or to have audit or to have audit carried out by third parties on limited IT infrastructure/ asset of contractor in case of any reported cyber sec urity incident or data breach of any type. 6. All information, drawings, designs and specifications generated for the contract shall, at all times, r emain the absolute property of the Purchaser. 7. List of IT Assets used for project shall be readily available with contractor and revised on any chang e. 8. Sub-contractor or other contractual manpower hired by Contractor shall also follow the Information Security best practices and all clauses mentioned above shall be applicable to them also.
